text:
Situation: Haloperidol lactate 5 mg/mL 1 mL vials are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 40 vials (5.3 days). Corvale General holds 140 vials (17.9 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 31 vials (15.7 days). A separate FDA shortage entry shows Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC plans to discontinue haloperidol decanoate injection with an initial posting date of 2026-01-09; this is a different formulation.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include haloperidol lactate as of 2026-10-21. The Fresenius Kabi discontinuation notice for haloperidol decanoate was posted 2026-01-09. No FDA inspection or enforcement action is recorded for the Fresenius Kabi plant linked to that NDC.

Our position: Current lactate injection stock is adequate system-wide but unevenly distributed. Corvale East is below a two-week buffer. The decanoate discontinuation does not affect lactate supply.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 30 vials of haloperidol lactate 5 mg/mL 1 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval.
2. Transfer 3 vials of haloperidol lactate 5 mg/mL 1 mL from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval.
3. Evaluate purchase from Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc. — needs buyer approval.
4. Evaluate purchase from BluePoint Laboratories — needs buyer approval.
5. Evaluate purchase from Caplin Steriles Limited — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or dose adjustments; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
